modules.title: First contact
modules.outcome: Introduce yourself and exchange essential personal, numeric, and time information.
modules.description: Meet Swedish sounds while greeting, spelling, describing origin and languages, using numbers, and telling the time.

vocabularyTargets.active: Greetings, names, alphabet, origin, languages, digits 0–100, contact details, and clock time.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Swedish vowels, sound length, hard and soft consonants, names, numbers, and times.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Vad heter du? · Varifrån kommer du? · Vad är klockan?
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Greeting, identity, and repair language returns throughout the course.

modules.title: People and places around you
modules.outcome: Describe people and a weekday, ask useful questions, find a place, and order at a café.
modules.description: Build simple Swedish clauses for people, routines, question words, location, and food service.

vocabularyTargets.active: Family, people, weekday actions, question words, places, food, drink, and prices.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Short present-tense answers and common information questions.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Vem är det? · När börjar…? · Var ligger…? · Jag skulle vilja…
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Names, origin, languages, numbers, and clock time from Module 1.

modules.title: Shop, describe, move, and meet
modules.outcome: Shop for essentials, describe things and rooms, follow directions, and arrange leisure time.
modules.description: Use noun gender and form, adjective agreement, quantities, imperatives, and modals in complete tasks.

vocabularyTargets.active: Groceries, quantities, clothes, colours, sizes, rooms, furniture, routes, hobbies, and invitations.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Definite forms, adjective agreement, plural forms, and short route instructions.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Jag skulle vilja ha… · Den är… · Gå rakt fram… · Vill du följa med?
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Questions, places, food, prices, people, and time.

modules.title: Conditions, changes, and past events
modules.outcome: Talk about weather, explain a health need, negate clearly, and tell what happened.
modules.description: Use seasonal language, symptom descriptions, main-clause negation, and common preterite forms before an integrated mission.

vocabularyTargets.active: Weather, seasons, symptoms, duration, negatives, sequence, and past events.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: V2 word order with inte and high-frequency preterite forms.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Det regnar… · Jag har ont i… · Jag kan inte… · I går… sedan…
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Personal information, schedules, directions, shopping, and invitations.

modules.title: Connect your everyday Swedish
modules.outcome: Talk about belonging, future plans, opinions, past relevance, and reasons.
modules.description: Use possession, reflexive reference, time frames, viewpoint verbs, and connectors in complete everyday messages.

vocabularyTargets.active: Possession, future plans, viewpoints, past experience, reasons, and contrasts.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Common reference words and connected clause patterns.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Det är min… · Jag ska… · Jag tycker att… · eftersom…
vocabularyTargets.recycled: People, routines, dates, questions, and practical messages.

modules.title: Home, people, and the four skills
modules.outcome: Describe familiar environments and people, shift register, and complete a four-skill bridge task.
modules.description: Move from connected everyday Swedish into more independent listening, reading, speaking, and writing.

vocabularyTargets.active: Housing, environment, people, routines, formal and informal messages, and task language.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Register cues and essential information across short texts and recordings.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Jag skriver för att… · Personen som… · Vad behöver jag göra?
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Descriptions, time frames, opinions, and connected clauses.

modules.title: Services, stories, and viewpoints
modules.outcome: Navigate services, react naturally, tell a connected story, and support a viewpoint.
modules.description: Develop from transactional exchanges into clearer narrative and opinion structure.

vocabularyTargets.active: Service actions, reactions, sequence, opinion markers, nature, and local environment.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Intent, attitude, and narrative order in familiar topics.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Vad bra! · Först… sedan… · Jag anser att… · Ett exempel är…
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Requests, past forms, reasons, comparisons, and public information.

modules.title: Health, work, and daily solutions
modules.outcome: Explain a situation, understand requirements, and negotiate the next practical step.
modules.description: Bring health, work, education, logistics, and social situations into one integrated clinic.

vocabularyTargets.active: Health, skills, experience, requirements, changed plans, neighbours, and solutions.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Conditions, requirements, reactions, and follow-up questions.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Jag har ont i… · Jag har erfarenhet av… · Kan vi i stället…?
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Register, narrative, opinion, service requests, and time.

modules.title: Work, study, leisure, and public services
modules.outcome: Respond to requirements, coordinate plans, compare study options, and act on public-service information.
modules.description: Move between job applications, workplace coordination, education, leisure changes, and a four-skill public-service checkpoint.

vocabularyTargets.active: Job requirements, schedules, study options, leisure arrangements, notices, and public-service actions.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Requirements, conditions, changes, and next steps in spoken and written information.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Jag uppfyller kravet… · Kan vi ändra…? · Vilka villkor gäller?
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Experience, comparison, deadlines, reasons, requests, and clarification.

modules.title: Connected communication
modules.outcome: Keep communication moving through stories, phone calls, and problem reports.
modules.description: Connect ideas, repair misunderstandings, and follow up without waiting for perfect Swedish.

vocabularyTargets.active: Connected stories, phone calls, complaints, follow-up, and negotiation.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Common Finland-Swedish and Sweden-Swedish variants in familiar contexts.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Har jag förstått rätt? · Det passar inte eftersom… · Jag ber om…
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Past forms, service language, time, and clarification.

modules.title: Explain your point of view
modules.outcome: State, support, qualify, and adapt an opinion.
modules.description: Build a position with reasons, examples, another perspective, and a practical response.

vocabularyTargets.active: Viewpoints, reasons, examples, conditions, benefits, drawbacks, and compromise.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Familiar informal reductions and opinion markers.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Jag tycker att… · Till exempel… · Å andra sidan… · Jag förstår att…
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Comparison, public information, requests, and past experience.

modules.title: Bring it to YKI
modules.outcome: Perform original unfamiliar tasks under time pressure and diagnose each skill separately.
modules.description: Practise Swedish instructions, timed workshops, and two original compressed four-skill simulations.

vocabularyTargets.active: Task language for gist, detail, intention, action, audience, purpose, and self-assessment.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: High-frequency natural spoken forms already met in context.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Vad tänker talaren göra? · Vad behöver läsaren göra? · Kan jag uttrycka det på ett annat sätt?
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Every major service, message, narrative, and opinion family in fresh timed conditions.
